title: DishTV STB Dongle
meta_description: Official Dish TV portal: offerings, plans, customer care, and products.
cleaned_body:
DISHTV SMART+ STB DONGLE
BUY NOW
Get the best companion for your Android and Google TV's
With Dish TV smart+ Dongle @2499*
3 months of TV + OTT Pack Included
Buy Now
FAQs
What is the STB Dongle?
The STB Dongle is a device that delivers live TV channels to your Android TV. It allows users to enjoy the best of both OTT apps (on your Android TV) and linear TV on a single interface. The STB Dongle is compatible with Google TV and Android TV only.
Is the STB Dongle compatible with all TVs?
The STB Dongle is compatible with Google/Android TV devices only.
What are the benefits of using the STB Dongle?
Here are some key reasons to purchase the STB Dongle:
Sleek Design:
Unique Compact and stylish design for aesthetic look
Single Remote:
Operate both linear TV and OTT content with your TV remote.
Linear TV + OTT Integration:
Access your favorite TV channels and streaming apps on a single interface.
Sneak Peek of Upcoming Channels:
Stay informed about new channels and content.
Favorites:
Mark and quickly access your favorite channels or content.
Reminders:
Set reminders so you never miss your favorite shows.
Parental Control:
Manage and restrict access to certain channels for your children.
What accessories come with the STB Dongle?
The package includes the following:
STB Dongle
USB Cable
Adapter (1A, 12V)
Please note - a dish antenna and signal wire will be need to be connected to the STB dongle. You can let our team know if you need a new antenna to be installed for you while requesting for the activation of the STB dongle.
